description: Use when a React 19 component forwards a ref and also uses it internally — a ref-merge helper, a `React.RefCallback` built with useCallback, or an effect that writes the forwarded ref — and a consumer's cleanup function returned from `ref={node => () => ...}` never runs on unmount.
